layout_and_spacing.philosophy: Generous Spacing System with Bento Grid & Mobile-First High Responsiveness

key_features_and_views.landing_page: Hero section with background video/canvas starfield, performance benchmarks (low latency <15ms, 4K 120FPS, instant play), catalog teaser, server nodes map.
key_features_and_views.dashboard_home: Featured game hero carousel, Recently Played, Recommended Games, Live Server Node Ping widget, Active Cloud Saves indicator.
key_features_and_views.game_catalog: Filterable/searchable library of PC titles (Elden Ring, God of War Ragnarok, Cyberpunk 2077, Black Myth Wukong, etc.) with game tags, metacritic rating, cloud save status, and 'Play Now' trigger.
key_features_and_views.my_library: User's saved games, total hours played, quick launch buttons, favorite titles.
key_features_and_views.active_game_session: Mocked video stream player with responsive touch controls overlay (for mobile: virtual D-pad + action buttons; for desktop: keyboard/gamepad indicator), expandable HUD panel (FPS: 60/120, Ping: 14ms, Bitrate: 45Mbps, Resolution: 4K HDR), full-screen toggle, stream quality switcher, and Quick Save trigger.
key_features_and_views.server_node_status: Interactive server node selection (São Paulo, Virginia, Frankfurt, Tokyo) showing CPU/GPU utilization (RTX 4090 rig nodes), queue length (0 or instant), network jitter, and ping latency test.
key_features_and_views.cloud_saves_manager: Detailed list of cloud save slots per game with thumbnail screenshots, timestamp, save file size, sync status, and restore/download/delete options.
key_features_and_views.user_profile_and_billing: Subscription tier card (Free Trial / Pro Pass / Ultra Rig tier), session timer, controller mapping settings, audio/video streaming config (codec: AV1/H.265).

component_strategy.shadcn_usage: Use Shadcn Dialog for game detail modals, Tabs for category switching, DropdownMenu for stream settings, Progress for server load & downloading, Slider for video bitrate/volume, Toast (Sonner) for save sync notifications.
component_strategy.custom_components: StreamPlayer (with interactive HUD & touch overlay), ServerNodeRadar (animated ping pinging), GameCard (hover zoom with glowing play badge), SaveStateCard (with state snapshot thumbnail).

testing_strategy.rule: Every button, link, tab, input, and state display MUST include a clear `data-testid` attribute in kebab-case.

instructions_to_main_agent: Build a complete Portuguese & English supported cloud gaming web platform called 'VORTEX CLOUD GAMING'.
Theme must be dark (#0A0C10 base) with high-contrast cyan (#00F0FF) and amber (#FF9F0A) accents.

Implement mock state for active sessions: user can click 'JOGAR AGORA' on any game -> opens immersive game streaming view with video canvas/placeholder, real-time animated HUD (FPS fluctuation, ping latency spikes/drops, bitrate counter), and touch gamepad overlay toggles.
Implement cloud save persistence in local state / mock API so users can create, load, and delete saved states for games like Elden Ring and God of War Ragnarok.
Ensure smooth navigation between Home, Catalog, My Library, Server Status, Cloud Saves, and User Subscription Profile.
Make mobile touch experience a priority: add virtual gamepad overlay when playing on small screen breakpoint.
Use data-testid on all interactive elements without exception.
